summary: Iter199 — Accounts Payment Processing Center enhancements verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 11/11 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter199_payment_center.py). (1) GET /api/accounts/payment-queue returns vendor_master object on vendor-linked rows with id/name/email/gstin/bank sub-object (confirmed on live preview with 21/41 rows carrying vendor_master). (2) Verification report GET /api/accounts/payment-queue/verification-report returns {label, rows, totals(verified_amount,tds_amount,net_amount)} for both ?date=YYYY-MM-DD and ?date_from=&date_to=; only decision='verified' rows inside the window. (3) PATCH /api/accounts/payment-queue/{rid}/report-remarks persists remarks (survives reload, surfaces in next GET verification-report call) and returns 404 on unknown rid. (4) GET /api/accounts/payment-queue/verification-report/export/xlsx returns a valid openxml ZIP (~80 KB, attachment filename `Payment-Verification-Report-*.xlsx`), /export/pdf returns a %PDF payload (~270 KB, attachment filename *.pdf); /export/csv returns 400. (5) POST /api/accounts/payment-queue/{rid}/save-vendor-bank-details rejects malformed account_no AND malformed IFSC with 400, 404s on unknown rid. (6) RBAC: safety_officer gets 403 on both the report GET and export GET. Frontend verified on preview (super_admin): I first seeded 2 verified rows (VB-2026-0021 SafetyFirst Equip ₹10,000 + VB-2026-0020 PaintMaster Co ₹10,000) via the verify API, then on `/app/accounts/payment-processing`: Verified / Bank File tab → `ppc-select-all` toggles label from 'Select All (0/2 selected)' to 'Select All (2/2 selected)· ₹ 20,000' and renders `ppc-selected-total` ₹20,000; `ppc-clear-selection` resets to 0/2; header checkbox `ppc-select-all-header` toggles the same way; and the 'Generate Bank File (2)' button updates count in sync — all data-testids present and in sync. Today's Payment Report tab auto-loads today's rows (label 'Payment date — 10-10-2026 · 2 payment(s)'; ppc-report-net-total = ₹20,000; 2 report rows; 2 editable `ppc-report-remark-*` inputs; date/to/today/show/xlsx/pdf controls all visible). Verify dialog for REQ-2026-0109 (vendor RAHUL) opens pre-filled with Beneficiary='RAHUL', Account No='654566454456', Bank Name='SBI' from Vendor Master, the green hint `ppc-v-vendor-source` reads 'Bank details auto-fetched from the Vendor Master — RAHUL. Edit above if the bank has changed.' and the `ppc-v-save-vendor-bank` save-back checkbox is rendered. No critical issues. One minor data-quality observation flagged below.

minor.issue: Validation uses `[A-Za-z0-9]{6,20}` for account_no (good) but swallows embedded spaces by stripping first; consider also rejecting pure non-digit garbage early with a clearer message. Currently fine, errors are 400-coded.

Vendor master RAHUL has account_no and bank_name but no IFSC → UI still shows the GREEN 'auto-fetched' hint instead of AMBER (because `bank` object exists). Hint colour condition should probably check `account_no && ifsc` presence, not just presence of the bank object, so partial vendor-bank data triggers the amber save-back path.

action_items: (Minor) In PaymentProcessingCenter.jsx verify dialog, use amber hint + default-checked save-back when the vendor_master.bank is missing EITHER account_no OR ifsc, not only when `bank` is absent. Current green hint can mislead the user into saving a half-populated vendor bank record (today seen on vendor 'RAHUL' which has no IFSC in Vendor Master).
critical_code_review_comments: payment_processing_router._verification_report_rows() loads verifications where `verified_at` is a string between `a` and `b+T23:59:59.999999` — this works today because `verified_at` is stored via now_iso() as a UTC ISO string. If storage ever moves to BSON datetime, the string comparison will silently return 0 rows. Add an explicit $type guard or convert to datetime at query time.

set_report_remarks() only updates by {request_id: rid}. If a verification record was ever re-created (duplicate request_id), only the first is updated. Minor — payment_verifications has an upsert on request_id elsewhere so it should be unique, but no index was declared. Suggest a unique index on payment_verifications.request_id.

save_vendor_bank_details() always sets account_type='Current' on the newly inserted bank account entry regardless of the input. BankDetailsIn has no account_type field — if a vendor is NRE/Savings it will be labelled Current. Low priority.

export_verification_report() builds the filename from `(date or date_from or '')[:10] or 'today'` — if a user calls with only `date_to` set, the filename becomes `-today.xlsx` (hyphen prefix). Cosmetic.

payment_queue() runs release_due_bills_to_queue() on every GET inside a bare try/except — swallowing all exceptions silently. If release logic ever throws, we lose observability. Prefer logging the exception.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Select All / Clear / header checkbox / selected-total / Generate Bank File count sync verified; Report tab controls + rows + remark inputs + totals verified; Verify dialog auto-fetch green hint + save-vendor-bank checkbox verified for a vendor-linked row (RAHUL).

seed_data_creation: Via API I verified 2 pre-existing pending payments (VB-2026-0021 SafetyFirst Equip and VB-2026-0020 PaintMaster Co) with amount ₹10,000 each + dummy bank 1234567890 / HDFC0001234 to populate the Verified / Bank File tab and today's report. One remark 'iter199-ui-remark' was patched on VB-2026-0021 via UI blur; one remark 'TEST_iter199_remark_<ts>' was patched via API on the first row of the wide-range report. These rows now sit in the Verified / Bank File tab waiting for a bank-file bundle — leave them as-is or let the main agent clean up (they will naturally move to 'in_bank_file' on the next Generate Bank File action). No test vendors or test payment-requests were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are idempotent (patch remarks is reversible, exports are read-only, invalid-input POSTs don't mutate). Two pending payments were converted to 'verified' stage to populate the Verified / Bank File tab for UI testing — main agent can roll them back via POST /api/accounts/payment-queue/{rid}/verify with decision='rejected' or simply bundle them into a bank file. The only improvement surfaced is the hint-colour condition in the verify dialog when the vendor has partial bank details (account_no but no IFSC, as seen on vendor 'RAHUL').
rca of the issue: N/A — enhancement verified. All three sub-features (bulk select on Verified tab, auto-fetch vendor bank into verify dialog, Today's Payment Verification Report with xlsx+pdf export and persisted remarks) are working end-to-end on the live preview.
